question: What youthful form results from constant yogic practice over sixteen years?
premises: Constant practice is performed through yoga
The duration specified is twice eight years
inference: Through constant yogic practice for sixteen years, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ interpreted as the form of sixteen years of age
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
